links.comparator_used: Original OHTS-EGPS model applied as-is (externally validated) to English EMR data, versus the model refitted (baseline hazard and coefficients re-estimated) on the local data
links.outcome: Discrimination (pooled c-index) for 5-year conversion from ocular hypertension to glaucoma
links.effect: Pooled c-index 0.67 (0.65-0.69) for the refitted model vs 0.61 (0.60-0.63) for the original OHTS-EGPS model; the original model's pooled calibration slope was 0.45 (0.38-0.51). The authors describe the improvement as modest.
links.quote: The overall refitted model performed better than the OHTS-EGPS model, with a pooled c-index of 0.67 (0.65-0.69), ranging from 0.65 to 0.75 between hospitals.

design_hint: local validation and recalibration of risk model
